notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds governmental (School Nutrition is a nonmajor governmental fund), so business_type and proprietary are null. Receipts lines from the governmental funds statement of receipts and disbursements, receipts page (p4, printed report p7, added by the find_pages v8 re-trim), Total Governmental Funds column, as printed; the statement omits the General Fund transportation fees 38,828 as a line although its totals include them, so that line comes from the General Fund budget schedule (p10) and report_discrepancies records it. Receipts sum to the printed total 35,490,525 (p4). Disbursement lines: first four from p1 statement of activities (equal to the p4 total column), rest from p5. Interfund transfers (233,901) net to zero in the total column and are not recorded at top level; other_financing 1,370,230 is the printed Other line in the total column (p5; includes disposal proceeds and other nonrevenue receipts). Roll-forward: 18,898,840 + 35,490,525 - 32,383,603 + 1,370,230 = 23,375,992. Detail: budget-and-actual fund schedules pp10-25 recorded (more detailed than combining schedules pp7-9, which were not duplicated); budget columns blank so budget_final omitted; Education Agency fund has no schedule (its 1,887,260 is eliminated by reclassifications). General Fund detail totals printed include other financing (disposal proceeds, interfund loan, transfers out). Balance sheet (user 2026-10-27): governmental lines from the governmental funds statement of assets, liabilities and fund balances (p6), Total Governmental Funds column (equals the p3 net position section). Debt services 1,994,284 split: QCPU Fund principal 165,000 and interest/other 114,965 from p22; Education Agency 1,714,319 has no printed principal/interest split, so it is debt service (principal and interest combined). Re-check 2026-10-28 (attempt 3): statement 'State receipts' 16,662,159 split (split_from) into Homestead Exemption 632,847, Property Tax Credit 5,197,467 and Motor Vehicle Pro-Rate 41,949 (summed from the General Fund p10, Special Building p20 and QCPU p22 schedules, which tie to the p4 fund columns 15,766,666 / 751,631 / 143,862 incl. School Nutrition 6,874), remainder 10,789,896 state aid (computed); school function codes applied in detail: 1200/1291/1292 Special Education Programs, 2410 School Administration, 3300 Community Service Operations (also the statement line); program lines 35xx/6xxx stay State Categorical / Federal Programs as the schedule groups them (p14). The statement's Instruction line includes special education and the reclassified categorical/federal programs (p7-8) and is not split, as no split of that line is printed. Read pages 1-25 of 25.
